faqs.question: How long do cordless handheld vacuum batteries last?
faqs.answer: Most cordless hand vacuums provide between 10 and 20 minutes of runtime per charge, which is designed for quick spot-cleaning sessions.

faqs.question: Can handheld vacuums pick up pet hair?
faqs.answer: Models equipped with a motorized brush roll (such as Shark UltraCyclone or BISSELL Pet Hair Eraser) excel at pulling embedded fur out of stairs, furniture, and car fabric.
